steps.text: 2:19 P.M. \ Clear
Village on the Ursus outskirts

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: *Gulp* Ah! This is some good beer. Fresh and smooth.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Ahem... Miss Shura...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Why the long face, boss? The beer here's made with local honey. It's great!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Plus, you're leaving tomorrow, and this is my last day working for you. Have one on me!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Absolutely not. I like to keep a balanced diet. I'm not in the habit of finishing a whole can of honey in the middle of the night, then binging sweetened booze the next day.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You were the one who said I could help myself to what's in the fridge!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Yeah, but, you know, within reason...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't you worry about your health?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Being a bodyguard is hard work. Need the fat and the sugar to get enough energy.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Like I said, 'within reason'!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Haha, gotcha, boss.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Say, I wanted to ask, do you have any plans after this job is over?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (Scratches head) I've thought about it, but I haven't come up with an answer.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Actually, I wanted to talk to you—

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Promotion on freshly-brewed honey beer! Buy one, get one free!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I'll have another!

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: One special honey beer, coming right up!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: —about this.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Did you say something? Couldn't hear.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I can't stay any longer, Shura, but there's something important that I want to tell you. This is no place to talk.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Of course, boss. With you all the way.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: You... huh? What's that...?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Why aren't you moving? Aren't you in a hurry?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Am I seeing things, Shura? Looks like there's someone running towards us.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: He's heading straight for you! Darn it, I knew the agent was lying when he said your background was clean!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Wait a minute! I told you, all I did was underground boxing. I've never been in the mob!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Really? That man looks like he's pretty eager to talk to you.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Er... well, actually, I do know him. Relax, just get behind me.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Well, if it isn't our boxing champion.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Get out of the way, Yevgeny. I don't have time for you right now.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: You quit boxing to become a bodyguard? Oh, I forgot, you're not a champion anymore.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Only an ass like you would celebrate a champion belt won for free.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Shura...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (It's like she's a completely different person.)

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: It wouldn't have been hard to take the belt from a rookie like you.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Oh yeah? Maybe you won't talk so loud with your nose snapped in half.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You think you would be running your mouth like this if I didn't get ambushed the day before the match?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Say, you...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Stop making excuses. It won't change the fact that you never showed up to the match.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You have no shame, do you, asshole?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Oh, mad now? What would the old man think, I wonder, if he knew that his finest student was licking boots as a bodyguard?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Don't you dare mention my coach!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Ooh, getting all puffed up in the cheeks, eh? Should we take this outside?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: That's enough!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Shura, I don't care what grudge you have against him, but your time doesn't belong to you. It belongs to the one paying your fee, in other words, me!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: So please don't waste your time and my money on... er... THAT.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Huh? Um, yeah, listen to boss girl and run away with your tail between your legs!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Huh? Isn't our work done already, boss?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: The work's done, but you're still on duty. I paid you for eight full hours. Let's go, Shura.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Alright... can't argue with the contract.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Plus, look at the waiters. They clearly don't want you fighting here.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Eh, well, yeah.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: If you aren't gonna fight, Olav, I'm outta here. I'm a busy guy, unlike you.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: If you had the slightest backbone, you wouldn't be showing off your cheap belt.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Let's finish that fight and let the outcome do the talking.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: But not now. I'll come for you later. I know where to find you.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I bet you're just gonna disappear like last time.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Oh? Getting cold feet, Mr. Champion?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: O-Of course not! Bring it on, if you dare... I, I'm not scared of you!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: ARE YOU DONE TALKING YET?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Why you suk—!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Let's go, Shura. We're too busy for... THAT.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Gotta go, Yevgeny. See you tonight. You'd better be there.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: 'That'? What does she mean by 'that'?
6:34 PM \ Cloudy

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: So why did you drag me back like this?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Remember what I told you about Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: It's a medicine company, right? The place you work at? You brought it up a bunch of times.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Are you going to keep working as a bodyguard after this job?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Who knows? I guess. It's not like people like me have much of a choice.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Well, Rhodes Island is hiring, and I bet you have the skills for the job. I'm thinking of putting in a good word for you with HR.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Really? Gosh... thanks, boss.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Plus, it'll only get harder and harder to hide your condition. Even though the authorities are lax out here, things will only get worse if you stay.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Sheesh, didn't know you cared about me that much... but is it really okay? You know most places don't tend to hire folks like me, you know, the Infected.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't say that. In fact, you're exactly the kind of person we're looking for. Rhodes Island has been striving to make the world better for people like you... people like us.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Oh my, I, I don't know how to thank you... I never imagined...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't go to that fight, Shura. You can have a new life. Leave the old one behind.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Boss...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I don't know how to explain it, but I have to go. It's important to me. I can't leave this place and feel at peace if I don't close the book on it.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I can't think about tomorrow when there's unfinished business today.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Then tell me about it, Shura. Convince me.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I always wanted to put on that championship belt... I'll never have the belt now, but I still want to prove to Coach that I'm worthy of it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Oh, I see... sorry. I know that he...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (Scratches head) Yeah, he's gone.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: When I was little, it was Coach who took me in, taught me how to punch and how to not get punched.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: It was hard enough for him by himself in Ursus, never mind having a kid around... he might have lived a better life if he didn't bother, but that was never on his mind.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: He wanted me to win the belt back all the way to the very end... this is the only thing I can do for him.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: ...I respect your decision, Shura.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Thanks, boss.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I looked into that man's background, and apparently there are some rumors of underhanded happenings... it could be nothing, but be careful nonetheless.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Yeah, I'll be careful.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'll buy you honey beer, if you win.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: It's a deal!
10:24 P.M. \ Clear

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: That suka just won't give up, will she?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: She's a lucky one... can't believe she's still walking after that.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I should have a talk with the Patrol Unit... make a few rubles while I'm at it.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Taking to yourself, Yevgeny?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: O-Olav? How did you know I was here?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I knew you wouldn't show up to the place, so I tried my luck and waited here.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I... I was waiting so long that I had to go for a walk!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Excuses, Yevgeny. If you're scared, you might as well just admit defeat and go home.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: S-Scared? Ha, very funny, Olav...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Maybe I won't bloody that pretty face of yours if you—
The man never gets the rest of the sentence out, as he finds himself staring at a fist mere inches from his nose.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Enough talk, idiot. Put your hands up.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Try not to bite your tongue, if you really have to talk.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I-I'll kill you, suka!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Bring it on!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (He's got some weight to his fists. Looks like he's not all talk.)

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Come on, stop dodging and fight me!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Your fault for being slow! Gotta work harder if you wanna hit me!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I'll have your head!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (His elbows are raised. Now!)

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Take this!
Her fists finds the man's ribs. Her foe raises his chin in pain, creating an opening.
Shura seizes the opportunity and closes the distance, landing a heavy blow on his chin.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: *Cough* *cough* My tooth!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Ha, big one too.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Wh-Why won't you just die?!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Die, die, I'm the real champion—

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Yevgeny, you dumbass—

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Wha—who's that? What's that?

steps.name: Shadow
steps.text: Blame... not the time... offended... you won't...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (Can't hear what he's saying, or see his face.)

steps.name: Shadow
steps.text: Hehe, farewell.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Stop—damn it, just before the match...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: (Is that a gold coin?)
The weapon is kicked away and clatters across the ground. Stunned, the man is unable to react.
The Ursus girl grabs his arm and wrestles him to the ground, choking him in a headlock.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: What's with the gold coin tattoo?!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: You... *cough*... help... can't... breathe...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Speak!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I've been looking for it for years. It was you all along!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: It was you who infected me with Oripathy!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: This is all your fault!

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I should have been the winner, the one to have my hand held high, the one to win that prize money!

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Help... *choke*...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: It's all your fault, your fault...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I should have won that prize money... it would have paid for the old man's medical bills...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Why did you do that?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: It wasn't me... the big boss... you wouldn't throw the fight... pissed him off... argh...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: What are you trying to say? You didn't have a choice? You were forced? Let me tell you. You're a coward. This is who you are, and you'll never change, right?

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I... sorry... was wrong... please... don't...

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Don't kill... me...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: No... enough... shut up...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Shut up!!!

a.text: Don't kill me. Don't kill me.
It is a common refrain for those on the edge of death.
A plea that goes unheard in the chaotic noise and smell of blood in the underground rings.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: ...I can't kill you. I just can't. Dammit.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I said this was a match... I won't go back on my word.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I don't kill in the ring. That's a rule I'll never break.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Look at you, dripping saliva and snot.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: To think that a piece of shit like you ruined my life.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: No, it's not worth it. Not for you.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You're lucky, trash. Get out of my sight.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: Ugh... *cough* *pant* *cough*

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: My fists are too good to waste on revenge.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Too good for you.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: *Cough*... I'm sorry... I won't do it again... don't kill me... *cough*

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Keep that tongue of yours to yourself. I'll pick up where I left off if I ever hear about you blabbing to the Patrol Unit.

steps.name: Muscular Man
steps.text: I, I won't... don't...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Get out of my sight. I never want to see you again.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Alright, boss, you can come out now. I heard your footsteps ages ago.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: So you weren't sleeping when I left?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: How could I sleep without the sound of you punching sandbags downstairs?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Oops, sorry. I didn't think you could hear me up there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Honestly. Well, never mind.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I thought you were going to kill him.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: And you didn't think to step in? Man, you're cold-blooded. That scares me.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Give me a break. I'm not that kind of person... and neither are you.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You'll really trust me so much, eh?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I know you have your principles, Shura.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Yeah... I still think of myself as a boxer, even if I don't box anymore.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: The match ends when my opponent is knocked out. A boxer doesn't go any further.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Even if it's not someone worthy to call an opponent?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: I've boxed for years, boss. Opponents come and go, in all shapes and sizes, but the ring beneath my feet...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Uh-huh?

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: ...It's always there.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: The ring matters to me. Every punch I throw, I have to be proud.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Well, you weren't exactly boxing in a proper ring just now.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: But the ring's always in my heart.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: You fought in underground rings, weren't you? It's not easy to stick to principles in a place like that.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Yeah. Too many things down there not fit for the light of day. Throwing matches, betting... that's rookie stuff.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: You get to see all the blood and gore you could ever want, if you have a deep enough pocket. Boxers there are less than animals... we're toys at best.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Maybe I would have become like them, a monster that only knows how to kill.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Hey, what's with that relieved look on your face, boss?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I just wanted to tell you how happy I am to have you as a colleague.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Boss... *sob*

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Man, you're making me blush, boss.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't get too carried away. You still have to put together a CV, be interviewed, assessed...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Oh, I don't want to think about any of that. Say no more. I just want a big mug of honey beer, then a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Sleep, eh? Look at your shoes first.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: My shoes? Oh, the bottoms are starting to come off. Heh, sorry, I've had these for a long time.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I think I have an extra pair. Try them on when we get back; see if they fit.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Let's head out as soon as possible. Who knows if that guy might change his mind and start running his mouth.

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: Sorry, guess I shouldn't have let him go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No need to apologize. His blood wasn't worth staining...

steps.name: Shura
steps.text: My super-duper fists?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No, your path to a new life.
